steps.name: Rose's Vow (1)
steps.objective: After talking with [Veled] in “Phobos,” go to [Adkina] in “Dragon Valley.”

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: What's going on? I didn't think I'd see it so soon... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I didn't come because I had something else to do... . I just ended up coming back to that area once something major was over.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Are you worried or something?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, just… . But what's wrong with Beled?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Why do I… .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I don't know about anyone else, but I think I should tell you.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Until now, I never thought that I was lacking in things like beauty or personality, but this incident made me realize that.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I am an imperfect being. I need to become more complete.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That goes for ordinary humans too.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Yeah? Still, it’s different from me. I am… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Thank you. Anyway, I will live my life looking for the reason. Still, I feel impatient. I know it won't be easy. hmm… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Even if it's something small, is there anything that can help? . How about asking Adkina for some advice?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Oh, I didn't think of that. I think I'll be fine if I hear some good stories from Mr. Adkina.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I want to go with you, but what should I do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I can't go to the Valley of the Dragon. Adrika may be okay, but deep places like valleys are considered unholy, so it is difficult to enter.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: So, when Uncle Adkina calls, we meet at the border of Phobos and Adrica and enjoy chatting... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then it's just me. Someone has to go... .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, it's okay. I decided to stay in the Valley of the Dragon for a few days, so I have to go back.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: It's not urgent, so come later when you have time to tell me the story you told me. Then I also talk about my beauty… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's okay. See you later then.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Gone, %s. By the way, why do you always refuse to talk about my beauty?

steps.name: Rose's Vow (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Rage Iris] in “Chaos Canyon” and obtain <Spirit Wings>. Then report to [Pionia] in “Mars”.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I couldn't see you and wondered where you had gone.  You went to Beled.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I just felt like I had to go to Phobos once, so I went. Oh, that's right. Beled… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Adkina about Beled’s concerns.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Beled is thinking a lot about his own existence. Like all life, it's important.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I hope this helps, but I wonder what a dragon can do. If only Beled felt more stable... .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Ah, maybe… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you remember something?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Maybe it's just faith.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Faith?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Beled will be less anxious if the person he cares about promises to trust him. I am a goddess like that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, that's it... . then… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (So am I Iris?)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Yes, the person that comes to mind right now is Faith. Then it's easy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will. If Beled was that kind of person, it would be Peonia. You know Adkina too, right?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I know because I heard it. I heard she was a woman with strong beauty who resembled the energy of Phobos. To the point where he doesn't hold back on nagging Baldrick... .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Peonia must also have faith in Beled. If you get the item I mentioned and bring it to Peonia, you will find out soon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: These are ‘spirit wings’ that can only be found in the world of imagination. It's not urgent, so take your time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think I found that in Chaos Canyon a while ago... shall we go first?)

steps.name: Rose's Vow (3)
steps.objective: Defeat [Asmodea] in “Rosengarten” and obtain <Red Rose Pendant of the Other Side>. Then report to [Pionia] in “Mars”.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: … Welcome. I'm a little busy, but it's okay to have time to talk to you. I expected to see you again soon, but... .

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: What's going on?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Adkina told me to give this to Peonia... .

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Adkina is a superhuman... . No, it's a dragon, so let's say it's a dragon. But what is this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Peonia says you will know when you receive this. I don't know exactly... .

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Then give it to me.
(Peonia looks at the spirit wing in %s's hand and takes it.)

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Uh… ?

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: What is this? The wings move so it flies. That's where Beled is... .

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: I don't know, but can I do something for Beled? What did Adkina say?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You said it was faith.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Faith?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, you just have to promise faith.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Hey, %s… .

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: I don't doubt Beled. Still, I want to show that I believe in it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You want to prove it. It may be a better way to show it through actions or objects rather than words.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Can I get the pendant that Beled has again?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm, I’m not sure about that… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ah, maybe… there might be another space. Similar yet different….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Dana said that. I would go and find some things...)

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Is it difficult? Then you don't have to... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. I think I can find it.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Yeah... . Then I will ask you a favor.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: You've already been there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Here is the item you requested. I found it in an inauspicious place, but it'll be okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't feel any power. It's really nothing more than decoration.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Thank you, %s.
(Pionia wears the pendant she received from %s.)

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: This pendant is pretty.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: When Beled did it, I thought it was just an ordinary rose decoration.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It suits you well.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Ah, yes… . If it helps Beled... .

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Anyway, thank you. The mayor's affairs are being sorted out somehow... .

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Not long ago, someone came from the Union of Light. He said he wanted to continue the exchange that had been cut off for a while. As if GIS Card is waiting for you... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You are a good person.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Yeah, that's what I felt. But what on earth was Mayor Klaus thinking? ?

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: I'm not sure.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: At least I thought the part I knew wasn't a lie... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know much about him, but what do other residents say?

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: It's half and half. The people who supported the mayor said they weren't like that, and the people who didn't like them said they thought they would be like that.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: There is evidence, there are witnesses... . That's because it's Beled and Baldric.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That might be ambiguous too.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: It's okay. I will do something.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you're a Peonia, you'll do well. I also feel reassured.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Thanks for the compliment. When the time comes, I will go to Beled and show him this. Please say thank you to Adkina.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will. See you later then.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Goodbye. %s.
(Pionia lifts the pendant around her neck and looks at it.)

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Peonia, you will do well. Because there are people who believe in you and rely on you. Don't become weak. For everyone who believes in you... .

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Beled… .

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: But you two, this is your first time meeting each other. Are you a problem solver? We will not be processing monster and demon extermination requests for the time being.

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: Haha, you saw us. How did you find it? We are not problem solvers, and as you can see… .

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: (Moon symbol tattoo on neck….)

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: It's a gift. This is the caramel cake I just made.

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: We just arrived, what on earth did you do?

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: I'll just say it's our family's secret. Raclette, you have some, so eat plenty.

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: I don't like sweets. That's why I didn't want to come with you... . And speaking of family, something else comes to mind that I don't want to remember. Phew… .

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Stop making jokes and tell me why you came to see me.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Moonlight… .

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: Then the story will go faster. Please provide a space where we can talk quietly.
